text_5052ed3d9c64: When a stop is detected, the application searches the DS100 coordinates stored on the server for the nearest station or reporting point within 1,000 metres. An unambiguous result prefills the location field with its code and name and is saved locally. Check the suggestion and change it if needed. Your own location entries are preserved. If the two nearest entries differ in distance by less than 25 metres, the field remains open for manual selection. Without a match or a connection, enter the location yourself; recording continues. Failed searches are retried during later updates. Manual stops need an actual accurate GPS fix within 30 seconds of their start; no location is invented across a GPS gap. Demo playback and read-only recordings remain unchanged. This lookup does not share your position with other drivers. Only Transfer adds the stop to the journey details.
text_256112e9f9f2: Detected GPS stops receive an editable DS100 location suggestion from the nearest stored reference coordinates.
